section: 2. Legend of the Young Dragon and the Black Dragon Slaying
description: The young dragon "Little Black" reveals the Dragonkin resurrection mechanism and its connection to the tyrant King Jack. The Black Dragon suddenly descends, the king's blood sacrifice conspiracy is exposed, the Dark Elf transforms into a weapon spirit, and the Bone Demon Dragon is born. The three grasp each other tightly, holding the Seven Stars, and leap from the mountain, plunging the dragon-slaying weapon into the Bone Demon Dragon's skull. The old kingdom falls with the tyrant.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Looking at this enormous giant juvenile dragon with my own tiny body

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " We are just unknown blacksmiths, wishing the great dragon lord good health today "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Alright alright, just call me Little Black... Hey, since you're blacksmiths, can you make something for me? "

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " Of course, we are blacksmiths, we'll do our best to satisfy customers "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Great, then help me make an iron flower! I want to buy an iron flower to give to mom~ "

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " I have an idea, since it's for your mother, why not do it yourself? We can teach you how, such a gift would be the best for your mother, right? "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " That makes sense! Then I'll trouble you! "

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Hands gather surrounding plant elements, converging into a grass-green iron sheet in the palms

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Call me Little Black! Of course I want red flowers, green branches! "

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " Wait a moment, the iron flower is too small for you, so it's affecting you. "

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: You.. can you breathe fire

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Don't even mention breathing fire, we Dragonkin, as long as we have a trace of breath left, can revive relying on that breath! Even something as small as Dragon's Saliva Wood can be easily handled. "

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " We might not appear in the future, so there are some small techniques inside. Let's do it this time, your mother will understand the sentiment. "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Great, hurry up and make it "

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Hands gather the gentle fire from the giant dragon's mouth, combined with the light of life absorbed while sensing the forest earlier, all turned into materials in the hands now

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # After taking Totorar's iron sheet, start folding, because I've done it since childhood, so particularly skilled. When almost done, remember something, then use psychic ability to control air to roll up some floral scent and hide it inside, also dot some light on it, finally tell Little Black how to trigger it

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " ... So that's how it is! Really thank you so much! "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Little Black grins foolishly, then flaps wings preparing to leave, " Thank you guys, by the way, keep the ambergris, the breath has already dissipated —— — "

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "... That was fast "

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Thoughts return, looking at the tool in hand, the knife handle already formed

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " What do you need this dagger for? Now it's the final step, also the time to inject will into it, you could say the weapon soul "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Ah, let me think... It should be about upholding justice, enforcing righteousness. Also a little bit of my own selfish desires~ "

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " Of course, this is also part of the artisan soul, weapons should conform to the owner's will and state of mind, owners should also pay attention to protecting the weapon's artisan soul "

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Then use What Matter is Pitiable?, trouble you~ "

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: What Matter is Pitiable?.. hmm

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: " Okay, although we forged the weapon, the weapon's true master is always oneself, so..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: " Good, then trouble you again to help design the life pattern~ "

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: [ Totorar the Blacksmith ] awakened his own power:

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .sh Insight d4

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The Dark Elf glared back, then suddenly laughed, "Alright, I really can't hide anything from you, as expected of weapon masters... This broken dagger in my hand is actually called the Phantom Dagger, it can transform into any shape and maintain it permanently."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: So... you.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The Fate Mark is the user's choice, equivalent to the weapon's destiny. It is both the starting point of the artisan's soul and will guide the artisan's soul and the user to the end. We cannot offer advice on this part; the user must only ask their own heart."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Make a Soul roll, challenge value 5.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: [ Master Artisan Elaria ] awakened her own power:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .sh Soul d4#5

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: As a flash of golden light passed, the Fate Mark on this dagger was clearly...!!!!!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Would you like to give it a name?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Since you have already made your own choice, then take it. It will be your reliable companion on the path ahead."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Then let's call it... Seven Stars!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "It's fine, as long as you like it."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Well then, two masters, bye for now~"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Silent, takes a long, deep breath.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Mm, goodbye. May your destiny be smooth and your path illuminate your true heart."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It seems she doesn't know the stories behind these materials."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Thank you!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Normal. Materials often change hands; some might be reforged, most are probably soulless."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh, next time don't enchant the chisel, my eyes are almost blinded."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: From that day on, the Dark Elf seemed to visit you every day. She didn't buy anything or gather materials, just came to see you. Sometimes she would buy small weapons to swing around, saying it was for arm strength training.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Seeing the ingredients on the hot pot were almost gone, she went to the back kitchen to wash vegetables and prepare more.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # Gets up to bring a wooden stool from the back.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I can't believe it's still open until now. I thought those bandits would have looted the shop clean."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Alright, alright~"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Haven't thought about going out to explore? Planning to keep working for that stingy king forever?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Need help?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Of course I know what he means, and I hope you won't stop me, but I also don't want to involve you. So, staying silent is the best help you can give me." Night Dream Flower looks at you and smiles. "Please."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "? Let me make another pair of gauntlets for you."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Alright~ Thank you for the trouble~"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Whether you return or not, consider it a token of our companionship, a keepsake of us being with you."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Night Dream Flower returns to her usual somewhat unreliable demeanor, scratches her head, and quietly sits to the side.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Should I forge a heart mirror too?" # Asking Totorar, somewhat unsure how to express it to the other.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "No need, no need. Wearing too much will actually hinder movement."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Alright..." # Takes out the iron flower made earlier based on Totorar's design and hands it over, still preserving some floral scent. "This was inspired during the previous forging, and I collected some of the surrounding floral scent. Since you're going on a long journey, this can at least remind you of this place and let this place remember you."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: No furnace fire is lit. Outside is empty. Toto forms an elemental ice anvil from the vast snowy elements. Gauntlets primarily require portability and defense, so they can't be too heavy or block swords directly, only useful for parrying, etc. The best materials are those with strong toughness and lightness. Winter also requires attention to cold protection, choosing brown-furred bear for the inner lining, with the outer layer being dark blue water armor condensed by his own ability. The inner wall of the water armor is engraved with acceleration runes inscribed by the Wine God's brush. In moments, two gauntlets are completed, perfectly matching the elf's attire. The inner walls of the gauntlets have soft brown fur, and the outside shines with a silvery-white two-layer armor. A line of foreign script is engraved: "A hymn to the courageous!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "……… Thank you."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Night Dream Flower's eyes gain a bit more determination. "Then, I'm leaving."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Seems to already know that someone's journey ahead is likely perilous. Returns alone to the stove to warm by the fire.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "If you find anything you need, send a letter back, we'll do our best. Of course, you still have to pay, preferably come back and pay us in person." "But since you're about to do such a great thing, we'll symbolically charge you one gold coin then."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Hahaha, alright." A gold coin is placed on the table. In the deep snowy night, a slender yet determined figure walks out the door. She carries a pair of gauntlets and a dagger, resolutely heading toward the palace. Even if this journey is perilous. Even if this journey is alone. Even if this journey ends only in sighs. But she is not alone. Absolutely not. Parting with Friends on a Snowy Night ————— Scene Switch "Hey, have you heard?" "What's up?" "Last night, someone broke into the palace and assassinated the king!" "Huh? Did the king finally die!" "Go away, watch your words. I heard the assassin failed, pretended to offer a knife to the king. Who knew the king seemed to notice something wrong and cut off the assassin's entire arm. But fortunately, the assassin still escaped in the end……" "Sigh…… A true warrior indeed." "Just don't know when this world will come to an end……" ——— Scene Switch Another year, this year's snow seems heavier, as if commemorating something, or calling for something. You and the little girl silently eat New Year's Eve dinner at home, occasionally glancing subconsciously at the door, then continuing the silence. "The first time in the heart." "The second time on the mountain." "White black black, white black black." "The last time kept the sky from soaring……" The little girl breaks the silence, softly singing a nursery rhyme. Hearing this稚嫩 voice, you can't help but sigh…… "Boom ————" Suddenly, a huge roar comes from outside, as if the entire world changes! When you run outside, the falling snow has turned black, and on the mountain, a black dragon is盘旋! "White, White Mountain has been breached by a Black Dragon!" "I remember the king is over there!" "Not only that, but also a bunch of children! Damn king…… Quick! Go save them!" The crowd starts surging toward the mountain, and you also run toward White Mountain. For some reason, you feel something is calling you…… Yes, that feeling is back… Seven Stars…?!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Push through the crowd to investigate.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # Look toward the direction of the call.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Your vision goes black, and when it brightens again, you are already on the mountain. For some reason, your bodies cannot move. Looking down, you find your souls are actually in a dagger…… precisely the Seven Stars! The location here is strange, seemingly the back of the mountain, where no one has been. But the dragon circles this area repeatedly, and on the ground, a faint magic flow of a magic circle can be seen…… "Night Dream Flower." A deep male voice comes. This figure, you've only seen from afar, seems to be…… The king?! And standing opposite the king is Night Dream Flower. At this moment, her arms are intact, but she is covered in wounds, holding a dagger horizontally, glaring fiercely at the king. "You pervert justice, actually trying to use the dragon's aura and blood sacrifice of children to make yourself a dragon descendant! For the sake of longevity, you'd sacrifice so many people for no reason!" "You still don't understand." The king's face is冷漠, raising his hand,魔力 vaguely gathering…… "For the kingdom, all of this is necessary. I'll deal with that Black Dragon soon, and now, you and your Longleaf Kingdom can die together…… …" "Descendant of the Longleaf royal family." The reason the fate纹 appeared as a king's fate纹 is actually because Ye Mengduo is a descendant of the Longleaf Kingdom! You are stunned by this news, but now doesn't seem the time to think about it…… Night Dream Flower is about to be hit! At this moment, you feel you can move. With this激昂 Seven Stars, the Seven Stars no longer silent, exerting full power…… … into battle!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # Gradually control the Seven Stars, causing them to tremble. Aibo! Let's use our bond! Friendship! Future! Then fly toward Night Dream Flower to block the attack and land in Night Dream Flower's hand (hehe).

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "This is… Seven Stars!" Night Dream Flower exclaims, then the Seven Stars blocks this魔力 attack for her! The king is slightly stunned. In that instant, Night Dream Flower suddenly bleeds black blood from her body, but her figure speeds up like a ghost. Holding the Seven Stars, with just one strike, she pierces the king's head! "Cough…… cough……" Night Dream Flower falls to the ground. The king falls死不瞑目…… It seems the black snow has a corrosive effect. Night Dream Flower, having just used a special秘法, is clearly not long for this world…… But she still uses all her strength to stab the Seven Stars into a piece of iron…? — Magic Cold Iron, destroy — Thus, only two items remain from the Longleaf Kingdom. You finally arrive here. Your bodies自行越过重重山峰, arriving at the battlefield where a quick and致命 fight just occurred. Your souls return to your bodies. Before you is the奄奄一息 Night Dream Flower.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: In the heavy snow, following behind the boss, holding a portable small stove for cold protection.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # Quickly step forward to check Night Dream Flower's condition, then look at Totorar. "I can't heal, I was purely a swift swordsman before."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Shrugs. "I'll try."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "…… You came…… Sorry, I missed the New Year's Eve dinner…… cough……"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Alright." # Takes over Totorar's small stove.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Night Dream Flower very勉强 raises a smile.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "How can you be absent, at least you have to try. This year's New Year's Eve dinner won't let you eat for free, you have to work and contribute too." # Then looks at the king, afraid he's not dead, pokes him a few times first.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: The king looks dead. His惊恐 eyes seem to hide some worry…… but it's all irrelevant to him now. He is dead.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Inside the small stove is a fire essence stone once stolen from the foot of Fire Dragon Mountain. Toto's finger extracts a strand of essence fire from the small stove, surrounding the elf. The火焰 melts snow crystals, producing steam. This is a special steam therapy taught by an elder in the far north. Then pulls out a small wooden stick from the back waist. The stick is engraved: "Seeking a glimmer of light for those on the other shore." The顶端 leaves sway in the steam, green light seeping into Night Dream Flower's wounds.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # Check the condition of the Seven Stars, then check what's special about the iron the Seven Stars is stuck in.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: This iron is just ordinary Magic Cold Iron, you've seen it before.

conversation.speaker: player3

conversation.text: Looking around, guarding against other attackers.

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player2

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Emmm, I've traveled through many countries of this world, and often encountered life and death separations. To be honest, I'm really not good at handling such things. So, I followed Elaria, worked for her, just to find a method to attach a soul to an object."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: # Watching silently, who knows if it's useful, but probably not.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I want to preserve your memory."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "...I was here...?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Perhaps, in the future, in some dusty corner, an object carrying your memory will be picked up by someone else."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: Night Dream Duo gradually becomes calm, then smiles.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Hurry up, I really can't block this one."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Only to see the small dagger Seven Stars in his hand glowing with an eerie blue light, flying into the air together with Night Dream Duo.
